name: Zero to Hero: Super Vision, Wealth and Love
original_name: Zero to Hero: Super Vision, Wealth and Love
overview: Bullied scholarship girl Gemma Lane gains super vision after an accident—letting her appraise antiques, predict stocks, and diagnose illness. She turns it into fortune, earns a mob heir's investment firm, and rises to America's richest—surviving assassination to build a world-class empire.
